purpose: Prepare English outreach masters for the three highest-readiness localization candidates without carrying forward the superseded annual offer or assigning a 29/39/59 monthly price arm before cohort freeze.

analyticsBoundary.copyRule: Any mention of measurement must remain conditional on separate privacy-safe measurement authorization and may describe aggregated signals only, never guaranteed outcomes.

drafts.subject: The Island on HOY – a quick idea
drafts.emailBody:
Hi The Island team,

I’m Jan and I’m building HOY for the Mar Menor. The idea is simple: guests shouldn’t have to spend ages searching; they should quickly find what genuinely fits tonight.

The Island is a strong fit because live music, karaoke and sport are exactly the kind of things people look for when they ask, ‘What’s on tonight?’. Your profile is already set up on HOY. As a partner, you could highlight current events and, once privacy-safe measurement is separately approved, see aggregated signals such as profile, directions or contact actions.

We are currently preparing a Founding Business test. The specific monthly offer for each participating business will only be assigned and frozen before outreach, so this draft deliberately contains no price.

If the idea sounds interesting, I’d be happy to show you HOY briefly.

Best regards
Jan

drafts.subject: The Celt on HOY – a quick idea
drafts.emailBody:

I’m Jan and I’m building HOY for the Mar Menor – not as another directory, but as a decision guide for one simple question: what should we do today?

The Celt is especially relevant for that use case. Irish pub, sport and live music are exactly the things guests often look for spontaneously. Your profile is already set up on HOY. As a partner, you could highlight events and current offers and, once privacy-safe measurement is separately approved, see aggregated signals such as profile, directions or contact actions.

We are currently preparing a Founding Business test. The specific monthly offer for each participating business will only be assigned and frozen before outreach, so this draft deliberately contains no price.

If the idea sounds interesting, I’d be happy to show you HOY in a short demo.

Best regards
Jan
